top_violation_types.title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation's play structures did not have the correct depth of loose fill. The play structures need six inches of loose fill.

top_violation_types.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: Based on information obtained during the investigation, the licensing incident and illness report was not completed.

top_violation_types.title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operation knowingly allowed persons to be present at the operation before receiving notification from the CBCU that the persons eligibility determination is Eligible, Provisional or Eligible with Conditions.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One child's file was missing a health statement.

top_violation_types.title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A sampling of children records were evaluated. One child's immunization record was observed incomplete.

top_violation_types.title: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18)(F))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: The operational policies did not include the criteria used to determine when extreme weather conditions pose a significant health risk that prohibits or limits outdoor play

top_violation_types.title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a child's diaper.

top_violation_types.title: Minimum Qualifications Employees and Caregivers - Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.1105(3))
top_violation_types.typical_finding: One caregiver did not have form 2985 notarized.
